name: FreshRSS
description: Follow websites and blogs in one feed reader.
compose:
services:
  freshrss:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/freshrss:latest
    container_name: freshrss
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:80"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
